start.title: Find your fan
start.intro: Every Civx fan learns its own remote, so Homey has to discover which one yours answers to. It takes about two minutes.
start.step1: You hold 1 and 2 on the remote, near Homey, so it can listen.
start.step2: Homey then briefly runs the fan at its lowest speed a few times, and asks you whether it reacted.
start.watch: Stand where you can see the fan before continuing, and make sure it is switched off to begin with.
start.note: Your existing remote keeps working — nothing is re-paired or overwritten.

listen.title: Hold 1 and 2
listen.instruction: Hold the 1 and 2 buttons on your remote together, close to Homey, until this fills up.
listen.timeout: Homey did not hear the remote. Move closer to Homey, hold 1 and 2 together for a few seconds, and try again.

probe.title: Which fan is yours?
probe.intro: Homey sends to many possible fans at once and then asks whether your light changed. That is why about nine questions is enough instead of 189.
probe.settling: Waiting for the blades to stop…
probe.noneLeft: No candidate matched. The fan may have been out of range, or an answer may have been the wrong way round. Please start again.
probe.lightOff: Switch the light off with your remote first, and stand where you can see it.
probe.useFan: The light does not work - use the fan instead
probe.halfNo: About half the answers will be "no". That is normal.
probe.sweep_light_on: Switching the light on in {{total}} possible fans…
probe.sweep_light_off: Switching the light off in {{total}} possible fans…
probe.alreadyPaired: This fan is already added to Homey — you can close this window.
